verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform, so per-number business hours are a fair axis. The evidence pack documents call routing, custom ring orders, phone menus, and Sona answering when the team can't, but none of it mentions business-hours schedules, open/closed behavior, or holiday handling. These routing features are adjacent and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number
